title: [C18T4] Average monthly change in prices of three metals
prompt: The graph shows the average monthly change in the prices of three metals during 2014. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The line graph depicts monthly percentage changes in the prices of three metals - copper, nickel, and zinc - throughout 2014.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, while all three metals experienced price fluctuations throughout the year, their values generally declined in the middle months before showing signs of recovery towards the end of the period. The most dramatic variations were seen in nickel prices, which peaked early in the year before sharply declining by mid-year.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Looking at nickel specifically, this metal recorded the highest monthly price increase of approximately 6% in January, followed by a steep decline to approximately 4% in February. After maintaining relatively stable price changes around 1% from March to May, nickel saw its sharpest price drop to -3% in June, before gradually recovering to end the year at roughly 1% above the previous month's price.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Regarding the other two metals, both zinc and copper began 2014 with modest price increases of about 1% and 2% respectively. Zinc then rose to nearly 3% in February before declining to -1% in June and leveled off for the next four months. Meanwhile, copper showed less dramatic changes, fluctuating between 0% and 1% for most of the year. By December, both metals recorded similar price increases of approximately 2%.
